title: Impulse Space light-up pill
description: A fully rounded pill button in 16px semibold type: solid (the primary colour) or outline (a 15% hairline). On hover two soft blurred lights, glow on the left and highlight on the right, fade in to 80% and grow to full size inside the pill in 0.4s.
notes: CSS only; with reduced motion the lights appear without the grow
name: impulsespace-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: primary fill · outline: a 15% hairline on the current surface

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link
